applies_to: Carrier AquaEdge 19MV two-stage semi-hermetic centrifugal chillers with Greenspeed Intelligence (magnetic bearings) and PIC6 controls.
summary: The 19MV's PIC6 controller offers BACnet MS/TP on RS-485 port J8 or BACnet IP on Ethernet port J15, with about 300 AV, BV and MV objects named after their CCN table and point. Commands use paired read (_rd) and write (_wr) objects for start/stop, occupancy, control point, demand limit, emergency stop, free cooling and heat/cool select. It repeats 228 of the 19DV PIC6 objects (all but the BACnet dongle input) and adds about 70 more, mostly magnetic bearing controller (MBC) points plus UPS battery, EXV and liquid bypass points.
notes: Objects marked Read/Write in the PV ACCESS column are mapped as writable; everything else is read-only.
No units column; values follow the BACnet Metric Unit setting (bacunit, default No).

The manual codes equipment status as a number (AV 7 GENUNIT_ch_state, "Chiller Status Code", appears to carry it): 1 Off, 2 Control Test, 3 Pumpdown, 4 Lockout, 5 Recycle, 6 Tripout, 7 Timeout, 8 Prestart, 9 Start-up, 10 Autorst, 11 Ramping, 12 Running, 13 Override, 14 Demand, 15 Shutdown, 16 Freecool, 17 Condflsh.
Alarm state codes per the manual: 0 Normal, 1 Partial (Alert), 2 Shutdown (Alarm).
The protocol appendix text refers to the "19XR PIC6"; the object table is the one printed in the 19MV manual.

source.title: AquaEdge 19MV Two-Stage High-Efficiency Semi-Hermetic Centrifugal Liquid Chillers with Greenspeed Intelligence, PIC6 Controls - Controls Operation and Troubleshooting (Appendix C, Table C BACnet Object Table)

integration.summary: Enable BACnet in the CONNECT (BMS Protocol) menu: J8 option for MS/TP or BACnet Enable for BACnet IP. Set the identifier and network, and put the chiller in NETWORK control mode. The chiller then starts when both BV 66 start/stop and BV 68 occupancy are true; write control point and demand limit through the _wr objects and read status, water temperatures and alarms.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_ctl_mode
minimum_points.why: Control mode: Local, Network, Remote, Local Sched

integration.enable: In NETWORK control mode the chiller starts and stops from the CHIL_S_S and CHIL_OCC points written over the network (both must be true). Use EMSTOP or the HMI to shut it down.
setup: CONNECT menu: Port J8 option 0 = None, 1 = BACnet MS/TP, 2 = Modbus RTU; BACnet Enable (bacena) defaults to disabled. The menu needs the Service password.
Defaults: BACnet network 1600, identifier 1600001, MS/TP MAC 1, MS/TP baud option 2 (38400), Max Master 3.
BACnet IP and Modbus TCP use Ethernet port J15 (default IP 169.254.0.1, mask 255.255.0.0).
BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP are mutually exclusive, as are BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU. Changing the protocol reboots the PIC6.
After changing the IP address, reboot or power-cycle the PIC6 to rebuild the BACnet stack.
gotchas: Write the _wr objects; the _rd objects only echo the current value.
Configuration parameters are generally read-only over BACnet; setpoints are read/write.
